Question B-006-006-005.

Why the correct answer is right: Matching at the feed point reduces high-SWR operation on the main feedline and can reduce feedline loss.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "Less transmission line loss": Correct. Matching at the feed point reduces high-SWR operation on the main feedline and can reduce feedline loss.
- sourceIndex 1: "More harmonic suppression": Those are different performance topics; feed-point matching reduces high-SWR feedline loss.
- sourceIndex 2: "Less atmospheric noise pickup": Those are different performance topics; feed-point matching reduces high-SWR feedline loss.
- sourceIndex 3: "More usable bandwidth": Those are different performance topics; feed-point matching reduces high-SWR feedline loss.
